cards.text: The word of the LORD comes to Ezekiel the prophet, and this time it's aimed at Gog of the land of Magog, the chief prince of Meshech and Tubal. God tells Ezekiel to set his face against Gog and prophesy against him. God's message opens like this: "Behold, I am against you, O Gog…"
God says He will turn Gog around, put hooks in his jaws, and bring him out. Friend, that's not a road trip, that's getting TOWED.

cards.question: God says He'll bring Gog out with all his ___.

cards.text: God says Gog will come with horses, horsemen in full armor, shields and swords, and Persia, Cush, Put, Gomer and Beth-togarmah from the far north will come with him. The biggest crowd in the junk drawer I spent years in was a pile of rubber bands, and this guy's coming with NATIONS.

cards.question: God tells Gog to get ready and prepare himself and all the company gathered around him.

cards.text: But this won't happen soon. God says after a long time Gog will be summoned, and in the latter years he'll enter a land that has recovered from war, on the mountains of Israel, which had long been desolate.

cards.question: By the latter years, who lives in that land on the mountains of Israel?
When Gog comes in the latter years, God says the people of that land will be living in fear.

cards.text: Then God says Gog and all his troops, with many peoples, will go up, advancing like a thunderstorm, like a cloud covering the land.

cards.question: On that day, God says thoughts will arise in Gog's mind. What will Gog devise?

cards.text: God says Gog will speak his plan out loud: he'll come against a quiet people who dwell securely.

cards.question: What will Gog say about the land of the quiet people he plans to attack?

answers.text: They live without walls or gates
Their land still lies in ruins

cards.question: Gog will say he's going up against this quiet land to seize spoil and carry off plunder.

cards.text: God says Sheba and Dedan and the merchants of Tarshish will ask Gog if he's come to carry off loot: silver and gold, cattle and goods.
Then God has Ezekiel speak to Gog again: "On that day when My people Israel are dwelling securely, will you not take notice of this?" Oh, Gog is going to notice, friend.

cards.question: God says Gog will come against Israel out of the far south.

cards.text: God says Gog will come as a mighty horde, all riding horses, advancing like a cloud covering the land. And God makes it clear that in the latter days He is the One who will bring Gog against His land.

cards.question: Why does God say He will bring Gog against His land?

answers.text: So the nations may know Him
So Gog's own people are punished
So Israel's army can be tested

cards.text: Then God asks Gog a question: is he the one God has spoken of in former days?

cards.question: God asks if Gog is the one He spoke of in former days through His servants, the ___ of Israel.

cards.text: Now God speaks about the day when Gog will come against the land of Israel.

cards.question: When Gog comes against the land of Israel, God says His wrath will flare up.

cards.text: God speaks in His zeal and fiery rage, and He proclaims that on that day there will be a great earthquake in the land of Israel.

cards.question: On that day, who does God say will tremble at His presence?

cards.text: God says the mountains will be thrown down and the cliffs will collapse.

cards.question: In that great earthquake, God says every wall will stay standing.
God summons a sword against Gog on all His mountains. What does God say every man's sword will be against?

cards.text: God says He will execute judgment on Gog with plague and bloodshed.

cards.question: God says He'll pour out torrents of rain, hailstones, fire and sulfur on Gog. Who else does God say it will fall on?

answers.text: His troops and the nations with him

cards.text: God says He will magnify and sanctify Himself and reveal Himself in the sight of many nations, and then they will know that He is the LORD. Hang on to that, friend, because this prophecy isn't finished yet.
